description: The day's machine-readable digest of the whole signal set — the CoinBucha Daily Brew. Takes no arguments. Returns { date, btc_price_usd, headline, signals_summary[], attribution, source_terms }, one summary line per signal with its strength, direction and one-line why. Example: {}. CoinGecko values carry attribution: "Powered by CoinGecko" and source_terms. Information, not financial advice. Every answer carries data_contract { source, as_of, status, corrections_url, license }. This server answers bounded questions, one question, one answer; for bulk, history, backfills and scheduled pulls use the CSVs and datapackage.json at https://coinbucha.com/data.
name: get_daily_brew
title: CoinBucha Daily Brew
